jei.weaponseffect.crafted_in: Crafted in a Gravity Core (Simple Ores): %s or higher
jei.weaponseffect.blindness_dagger.info: Hits inflict Blindness. While held you are immune to Blindness. Right-click: Smoke Bomb, blinds the mobs around and makes you invisible.
jei.weaponseffect.swiftness_dagger.info: Hits inflict Poison. While held you get Speed VI and are immune to Slowness. Right-click: Dash, rush where you aim and hurt every mob you pass through.
jei.weaponseffect.poison_sword.info: Hits inflict a strong Poison. Right-click: Poison Cloud where you aim. While held you are immune to Poison.
jei.weaponseffect.ice_sword.info: Hits freeze the target: extreme Slowness that drains life. Right-click: Ice Shard, ice shards fly where you aim. While held you are immune to Slowness.
jei.weaponseffect.lance.info: Hold right-click and release to throw it like a trident. Rain of Lances: when it hits, lances fall from the sky. While held you get Strength II and Speed II and are immune to Slowness.
jei.weaponseffect.wither_sword.info: Hits inflict Wither. Right-click: Wither Rain, launches wither skulls. While held you get Resistance and are immune to Wither.
jei.weaponseffect.fire_sword.info: Hits set the target on fire. Right-click: Blazing Gaze, flames where you look. While held you get Fire Resistance.
jei.weaponseffect.gimlis_axe.info: Hits inflict Slowness. While held you get Strength II and Resistance III. Right-click: Boomerang Axe, thrown where you aim and comes back.
jei.weaponseffect.darkness_mace.info: Hits inflict Darkness and Slowness. While held you get Strength III and Resistance III and are immune to Darkness. Right-click: Dark Slam, leap and slam; mobs touching the darkness zone become Disoriented (they wander and can't attack).
jei.weaponseffect.hammer.info: Hits inflict Slowness. Right-click a block: Explosion, massive damage around it. While held you get Strength VIII.
jei.weaponseffect.wings_of_doom.info: Hits inflict Poison, Wither, Slowness, Blindness, Darkness, Weakness, Mining Fatigue and fire. Right-click: creates a Black Hole that consumes everything. While held you get many buffs and immunities.
weaponseffect.level.ready_tooltip: Ready! Right-click a Gravity Core (tier %s or higher) to start the Soul Ritual
weaponseffect.level.ready: %s is ready for level %s: start the Soul Ritual on a Gravity Core
weaponseffect.ritual.already: You already have a Soul Ritual running
weaponseffect.ritual.tier: This weapon needs a %s or higher
weaponseffect.ritual.terrain: The ground around the core must be flat and open (%s bad places)
weaponseffect.ritual.bar.finishing: Soul Ritual - the souls enter the weapon
weaponseffect.ritual.failed: You died: the Soul Core broke and the weapon lost all its XP
jei.weaponseffect.soul_core.info: Used in the Soul Ritual: when a weapon's XP is full, right-click a Gravity Core with it. Survive the waves inside the dome to level the weapon up. The Soul Cores are always spent; the Gravity Core is never spent. Level I->II: 1, II->III: 2, III->IV: 3, IV->V: 4.
weaponseffect.command.no_weapon: Hold a weapon of Weapons Effect in your main hand

weaponseffect.levelup.wither_sword.5: Blue skulls that give Wither III

weaponseffect.levelup.ice_sword.5: Shards rain from the sky and leave ice lotuses that explode and freeze

weaponseffect.levelup.poison_sword.5: The cloud also gives Wither and Nausea
